thread:
Maya Singh: Heads-up 3- Aurelia Systems wants signed orderform + countersigned MSA before POC kickoff. They insist invoices to their EU subsidiary, BYOK/HSM attestation, and net45. Can legal/finance accept a delegated e-signatory for the EU company? :thinking:

Devon Clark: We can provision Private/Dedicated for the POC. BYOK/HSM only on Private. What format of attestation will they accept (auditor report, vendor cert)?

Elena Ruiz: Maya 5 pls upload the orderform + redline. For proxy signing we require delegation evidence: POA, board resolution, or signed delegation letter plus registry lookup. EU proxies usually OK with scanned delegation + registry match.

Maya Singh: Uploaded: https://drive.redwood.example/Aurelia_Orderform_v1.pdf and Aurelia_MSA_redline.docx

Omar Haddad: Billing note: net45 okay with a valid PO and credit pass. If procurement is slow, offer proforma/prepay to start the POC. Need full invoice name + VAT.

Maya Singh: They confirmed invoice to "Aurelia EU GmbH" (VAT EU-AU-9001). Procurement says PO in ~10 business days.

Priya Rao: Skimmed the redline. They added a BYOK clause: "Customer-managed HSM; quarterly attestation; no key export." Our position: permit customer-managed HSM on Private only; require independent attestation within 30 days of go-live; BYOK/export requires a security exception. I'll draft tracked changes.

Elena Ruiz: Signature routing they want: billing contact signs orderform first, then MSA to exec. DocuSign chained envelopes OK. Proposed envelope order: ["billing_contact","legal_counsel","exec_signatory"]. We can attach delegation docs to the envelope.

Devon Clark: SLA ask 5 they requested 99.99% with credits. We can offer 99.95% for Dedicated with a capped credit schedule. 99.99% requires multi-region Dedicated + active failover and an SLA uplift fee; Product/Ops must sign off and customer must commit to a 12-month reserved capacity.

Priya Rao: Suggest counter language: conditional 99.99% available as a paid add-on (SLA-UPLIFT-4N) with 12-month reserved capacity and defined credit cap. That keeps exposure bounded.

billing_bot: Proforma flow: if customer pre-pays, send billing contact to billing@redwood.example. We can issue proforma within 24h. Net45 starts after PO validation if PO later provided.

docu_sign_bot: Envelope created for MSA/orderform (attached docs). Recipients: Priya Rao, Maya Singh, billing_contact. Envelope ID: env_aurelia_4b2f.

Maya Singh: Timeline: Aurelia wants countersign by COB Thursday. Legal 5 possible?

Priya Rao: Tight but feasible if we finalize HSM and SLA counters by tomorrow morning. I'll post tracked changes and route back to the envelope. Maya please request delegation docs and confirm whether they require notarized POA or scanned delegation.

Omar Haddad: Finance will place account on credit hold until PO arrives unless they prepay. If they accept 12-month reserved, we can discuss credit terms.

Maya Singh: Action items: Priya to upload MSA counters, Devon to estimate ops uplift for SLA-UPLIFT-4N, Omar to confirm proforma/credit flag, Elena to configure DocuSign envelope chain. I'll get delegation docs from Aurelia. Thanks. :thumbsup:
